# Temple Scroll Column 67 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 67 | **Condition:** fragmentary (final column)

---

**67:1** Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field.

**67:2** Blessed shall be the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground and the offspring of your livestock — the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

**67:3** Blessed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.

**67:4** Blessed shall you be when you come in, and blessed shall you be when you go out.

**67:5** The LORD will cause the enemies who rise against you to be routed before you. They will advance against you from one direction and flee from you in seven directions.

**67:6** But if you do not obey the voice of the LORD your God, to keep and to do all his commandments and his statutes, [...] all these curses shall come upon you and overtake you.

**67:7** Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field.

**67:8** Cursed shall be your basket and your kneading bowl.

**67:9** Cursed shall be the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your ground, the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks. [...]

**67:10** [...] The LORD will send upon you the curse, the confusion, and the rebuke in everything you undertake, until you are destroyed and quickly perish, on account of the evil of your deeds, because you have forsaken me.

**67:11** [...] The LORD will afflict you with pestilence until he has consumed you from the land you are entering to possess. [...]

**67:12** [...] because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart for the abundance of all things. [...]

**67:13** [...] you shall serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger and in thirst and in nakedness and in want of all things. He will place an iron yoke upon your neck until he has destroyed you. [...]

**67:14** [...] All these curses shall come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the voice of the LORD your God to keep his commandments and his statutes that he commanded you. [...]

---

*SOPHIA notes: The final column of the Temple Scroll. Council used a blend of EMET and LOGOS. "Fruit of your womb" (EMET) retained over "fruit of your body" (LOGOS) and "your children" (PNEUMA) as the traditional biblical formula. "Kneading bowl" (EMET/LOGOS) over "mixing bowl" (PNEUMA). "The curse, the confusion, and the rebuke" (EMET) preserves the Hebrew triad better than LOGOS's "calamity, panic, frustration" or PNEUMA's "disaster, confusion, defeat." "Forsaken me" — first-person divine voice maintained to the end. All [...] marks are genuine manuscript lacunae. The scroll's ending is lost; column 67 likely continued with further curse material from Deuteronomy 28.*
